title: Hunts FH-032S: Plug live partner state and the finale broadcast into route health

source.ref: Split from FH-032 (2026-11-16): route health shipped over the tables on main; FH-029 and FH-031 were being built in parallel and are not read yet.

detail:
Route health (lib/hunts/route-health.ts) decides which Spaces are venues in one function, activeVenues, from the hunt_partners rows with the authz liveness rule, and reports the Hunt outbox as its message status. Owed by an agent once FH-029 and FH-031 are on main: read the live partner state from lib/hunts/partners.ts in activeVenues (pinned terms, the named steward, a withdrawn venue keeps its historic counts and drops from the active list), and add the finale broadcast state from lib/hunts/rally-finale.ts beside the outbox counts on /hunts/<slug>/health. Also link the two pages (/hunts/<slug>/health for organisers, /hunts/<slug>/report for venue staff) from the Trail's manage screen. Done when: a venue withdrawn through the partner flow leaves the organiser's active venue list on the next read while its past counts still reconcile, and the organiser sees whether the finale broadcast went out. Requires: FH-029, FH-031, FH-032. Owner role: Operations and analytics.

Built 2026-11-16. lib/hunts/route-health.ts activeVenues now asks lib/hunts/partners.ts partnerLive, the rule the claim path and publish use. A venue withdrawn, suspended or revoked through the partner flow drops out of venues on the next read and its counts move to formerVenues (with why it ended), so the venue totals still reconcile; partnerStanding gives each live partner's named steward and whether the terms it pinned are today's (PARTNER_TERMS). The finale is projectFinale from lib/hunts/rally-finale.ts with no player's seat in it: none, unavailable (cancelled, missing, or the host partner is no longer live) or showing with the host Event, going and places left. lib/hunts/route-health-store.ts reads the steward and terms columns, the stewards' display names, and the current version's finale Event through rally-finale-store loadHostEvent. /hunts/<slug>/health shows Steward and Terms columns, a former venues table and a Finale section beside Messages; the Trail editor's publish step links Route health and Venue report once the Trail is published and HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED is on. The venue's own view is unchanged. There is no separate finale message sender on main: the finale goes out as the panel on every player's Trail page, which is what the organiser now sees. Tests: lib/hunts/route-health-partners.test.ts. No migration, switches stay off.
